item.title: By: SGf

item.description:
Wow - natural cleaning products! That's a terrific idea. I hear they work great, too. =D
I'm evil; my used plasticware goes in the trash. Although I re-purpose them when I can - that useless plastic knife becomes a tea stirrer before it meets its demise... Yes, I drink tea.
item.content:encoded:
Wow – natural cleaning products! That’s a terrific idea. I hear they work great, too. =D

I’m evil; my used plasticware goes in the trash. Although I re-purpose them when I can – that useless plastic knife becomes a tea stirrer before it meets its demise… Yes, I drink tea.
